title: The Monsoon of the Upper Fly River
author: Ines Vasquez
blurb: Astrid Yarrow, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
